title.ru: Летающая вилла в стиле Bioshock Infinite
title.de: Fliegende Villa im Bioshock Infinite Stil

generated.description: A floating villa inspired by Bioshock Infinite, built mostly from stone slabs, stone bricks, spruce planks, bricks and quartz pillars, with lime and orange terracotta accents. It is about 31 wide, 58 high and 40 deep, and the structure includes chests, furnaces, hoppers, droppers, flower pots and signs as interior details.
